signal_text: Gumroad's Terms of Service (effective January 1, 2025) states that unless a user opts out within 30 days, disputes must be pursued individually rather than as class actions, the right to jury trial is waived, and disputes are governed by California law consistent with the Federal Arbitration Act.
subject_exact: Gumroad Terms of Service mandatory arbitration and class action waiver clause with California law jurisdiction
local_qualifiers: UNLESS YOU OPT OUT OF THE AGREEMENT TO ARBITRATE WITHIN 30 DAYS
governed and interpreted by and under the laws of the State of California
extraction_notes: Mandatory arbitration with opt-out window of 30 days. California law governs. Class action waiver explicit. Not a commercial/pricing claim; this is a legal dispute resolution policy clause.
